title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol! — Episode7 The View I Wanted to See

meta.Episode: Episode7 — The View I Wanted to See
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: Several dozen minutes later
Idol Lovers Stage

rows.Speaker: Male MC
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, I hope you all enjoyed being dazzled by all our wonderful idols!

rows.Speaker: Female MC
rows.Line:
Weren't they all just the cutest?!
However, we still have a fun surprise in store for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Male MC
rows.Line: That's right! Next up are our special joint performances! Let's welcome our first combo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is it.
Our joint performance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes!
We're third on deck if I recall...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our performance earlier ended up being quite a lot of fun, so let's keep doing our best together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku's way more excited than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's common for people to feel this sort of high after performing on stage, but I don't think that's the reason...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Airi really turned up the heat, so we need to do everything we can to maintain it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't wait to dance. I can't wait for our next turn on stage...)
Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, ReLight...!

rows.Speaker: ReLight Member
rows.Line:
Great performance just now!
That was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
It really was!
I was on the edge of my seat the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you. We couldn't feel more honored.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seeing your performance just got us so stoked...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we felt that we had to do our absolute best to follow you up. So...
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: ReLight and MORE MORE JUMP! We need you all on standby!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like we'll have to wait to talk about this.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Unfortunately.
Please tell us all about it later! But...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to say right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right now?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We want this joint performance to be something really incredible, so we promise to not embarrass all of you from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
I bet your arms are so sore from keeping them up in the air!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: But I think you should have one last hurrah before you collapse!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: So, let's keep having fun together until the end!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Whoa...!
This is so different from the rehearsal and the way they performed a second ago...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And we're supposed to jump in during the interlude. We need to get our timing just right.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's okay. The energy is still here.
All we have to do is keep revving the engine.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can hear the crowd and feel the electricity in the air... Now, remind yourself of what you have to do.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold up, you guys!
I know you can make more noise than that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's time for ReLight and MORE MORE JUMP! to do a joint performance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll need you all to cheer for both our groups!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Make some noise!!!
se_event_chase_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
(That was close...
I almost forgot what I was supposed to do...)
se_event_chase_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: (I've never heard the crowd cheer like this during a ReLight show...)

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
(Momoi's command was so compelling.
If I tried to do what she just did, I'd never achieve the same result.)
se_event_chase_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: (She has a natural talent for getting a crowd going, but there's more to it than just that...)
se_event_chase_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: (It's because it's her, they're going wild.)

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: (Which means we have to do what we can to maintain this energy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Their voices are booming and their performance went up a notch...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And their timing couldn't have been better. They got the audience all on board.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I've never seen an audience get so excited...
And we've never performed in front of so many people...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Under normal circumstances, I'd already be a nervous wreck...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But things are different.
The way my heart's racing...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Everyone's attention is focused on the stage. On us.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The way they're singing along. We've become one.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our hearts have melded together.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is my chance.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To reach that place...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To see that view...!)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
(This is really fun.
I've never felt so close with the crowd before.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (All the hope we've been trying to spread to them... They've taken it and returned it back tenfold.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (We're reaching them and they're reaching us...)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (I feel like the greatest idol in the world!)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (And this is all being made possible by...)

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Let's sprint to the finish, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is way too much fun!
I don't want this to ever end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a once-in-a-lifetime moment for ReLight, MORE MORE JUMP! and all of you in the audience!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We need to savor every second of it.
So, let's use every bit of energy we have left...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And turn this moment where our hearts have become one into a really special memory!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (Wait, that look... That's so not fair.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (She just went from being really cool to the Momoi... The Airi we all know and love...)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
(This is too much.
After seeing, I...)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
(I have to do what I can!
I have to help make what she said a reality.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: (I have to do everything I can to make this a truly special moment using all the energy that I have left!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Th-This is insane!
MORE MORE JUMP! and ReLight are way too awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I'm so glad we came today.
I wasn't expecting to see such an incredible show...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I'm beyond moved. I'm starting to tear up...

rows.Speaker: Record Company Employee
rows.Line: I think we've reached this event's peak.

rows.Speaker: Show Producer
rows.Line:
I agree.
Honestly, I feel bad for the other groups performing after this.

rows.Speaker: Show Producer
rows.Line:
That's Mr. Hiiragi for you.
He sure knows how to put great groups together.

rows.Speaker: Show Producer
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I don't want this song to end...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wanna keep having fun with everyone here.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But that's not possible...
So we have to do what Airi said.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We have to use every bit of energy we have left to make this day truly unforgettable!)

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: (More! More!)
